Before we begin

A few helpful
details.

What does Ms & Mrs Fabrics and Boutique specialise in?+

We specialise in high-neck blouses and offer pattern blouses, bridal blouses, Aari work, western gowns and clothing customisation.

Where is the boutique located?+

You can find us on 4th Main Road, Thirupathi Nagar, Kolathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600099. Contact us before your visit to arrange a convenient time.

How can I discuss a design?+

WhatsApp us on +91 94442 48866 with your reference images, fabric or saree details and required date. You can also call or email to begin the conversation.

Can I request a customised blouse or gown?+

Yes. Share your design preferences and occasion with us. We will discuss the details, availability, pricing and next steps directly with you.

Where can I find prices and completion times?+

Each request depends on the design, fabric and level of detailing. Please contact the boutique for a quote and to confirm a suitable timeline.
